hardware: one node, 8 GPUs (NVLink), 2.9 TB host RAM, driver 580.126.09
software: Python 3.10, torch 2.7.1+cu128 with nvidia-nccl-cu12 2.27.3, DeepSpeed 0.18.5, accelerate 1.12.0, transformers 5.0.0rc0, flash-attn 2.8.3

workload.recipe: upstream scripts/train.sh: torchrun, 8 ranks, train/train.py --deepspeed configs/zero1.json --config configs/robotwin.yaml
workload.model: Motus: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video expert, frozen Qwen3-VL-2B, action and understanding experts (8.0B parameters, 5.9B trainable), fine-tuned from the released Stage-2 checkpoint
workload.data: RoboTwin 2.0, all 50 tasks, aloha-agilex clean (50) and randomized (500) demonstrations, converted with upstream's converter: 27,244 episodes
workload.mode: upstream default (non-deterministic kernels); every rank's torch, Python and numpy streams seeded with a fixed seed + rank

measurement: Host time per iteration on rank 0: time between the starts of consecutive training steps (includes the data wait). Headline window: iterations 21-150 of each run, which contain no validation and no epoch boundary.

configs.label: All four switches (the agent's final configuration)

notes: The baseline ran 150 iterations; it has no validation or epoch boundary in its window.
